capabilities: Lock configured folders with a password and hide their contents in the file explorer
Hide locked folders in Finder via chflags (macOS)
Encrypt folder contents into encrypted envelopes with AES-256-GCM
Write optional plaintext .ofc-backup files before encryption
disambiguation: Folder lock mode only hides files from the file tree and Finder; it is not encryption, which is the separate content lock mode.
extras: README warns Finder hiding is not encryption and can be bypassed by other apps, Terminal, backups or sync history, and that plaintext .ofc-backup files leave readable copies in the vault; manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hide or password-protect a folder's contents, either inside the app or on disk.
summary: Folder-protection plugin that password-locks folders in the file explorer and optionally encrypts their Markdown files with AES-256-GCM.
